Measure API latency, database time, ingestion throughput, normalization/deduplication throughput, search latency, CPU/memory and background failures. Test realistic datasets such as 100K, 500K and 1M jobs. Optimize only from measurements using projections, indexes, batching, caching, connection pooling and appropriate bulk operations. Add structured logging, metrics and tracing/Application Insights where appropriate.
